Video enhancement
Output resolution
Up to 1080p
Lower GPU memory use. Fit the display, up to 1920 × 1080.
Native display · up to 2K
Fit your screen, up to 2560 × 1440. Higher GPU and battery use.
Processing mode
Enhance anime on your device. Higher GPU use can increase heat and battery consumption.
Off
Play the original picture.
Anime4K · Light restoration
Restore lines without upscaling. Uses the small CNN model.
Anime4K · Mode A
Stronger restoration for blurry lines, with up to 2× upscaling.
Anime4K · Mode B
Softer restoration for mild blur and aliasing, with up to 2× upscaling.
Anime4K · Mode C
Denoise and upscale up to 2× without a separate restoration pass.
FSRCNNX · 2×
Upscale detail using the 8-channel model. Requires more GPU work.
Anime4K GAN · Experimental
Small 2× GAN model. May change textures or introduce artifacts.
Uses bundled shaders in the Windows player. Upscaling runs on eligible video sizes up to the selected display ceiling. Light restoration keeps the source resolution.
